title: Opening of interview with Milford Dollier
summary: Russell identifies the date, place and the correct spelling and pronunciation of Dollier's name.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: This is Bill Russell interviewing Mr. Dollier up at 732 St. Peter Street. And the date is, I have to look it up, what is the date? It's May the 22nd, I believe. May 22nd, 1965. Your name is spelled D-O-L-L-I-O-L-E. I have your card here and it's pronounced Dollier, is that right?
